audit.why: Four spikes, correctly placed at 3-5 / 6 / first item / late; the level-6 one just described the wrong ability as her answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls Steadfast Presence her PASSIVE in spikes[1] and mid, and whys[3] says 'passive block'. Steadfast Presence is her W — an active on 20/18/16/14/12 — and her passive is Iron Ambassador, the buckler shield. The layer also never states that when W stops a dash, it also GROUNDS you.
audit.why: If a player believes the dash-block is a passive, he concludes there is no window and stops looking for one. It is a 20-second button with a real cooldown, and baiting it is the entire matchup. The grounding is why a stopped Alpha Strike leaves you unable to leave, not merely unable to arrive.
audit.corrected: Named as Steadfast Presence (W) with the 20s rank-1 cooldown wherever it appeared, and the grounding stated in report[5].
sources: enemyKit W 'Poppy can activate Steadfast Presence... stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded'

edits.before: By levels 4-5 it's skill-based around dodging her E and passive block.
edits.after: By 4-5 it's skill-based: bait Steadfast Presence (W), then dash in.

edits.before: Her Steadfast Presence and stun still deny your level-6 dive, keeping it even.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence (W) stops dashes outright, so it denies your 6 dive.

edits.before: Keeper's Verdict can cancel your all-in and knock you across the map, but more relevantly her passive Steadfast Presence blocks your Alpha Strike dash and stops your engage, so don't dive her yet.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict is 140s at rank 1, but her real answer is Steadfast Presence (W) — an active on 20s at rank 1 that stops dashes dead and grounds you when it does, so bait it before you dive.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are skill-based — her passive can block your Alpha Strike engage and her E stun is lethal near walls, so dash only when her cooldowns are down, then punish the opening.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are skill-based — Steadfast Presence (W) is a 20s active that stops Alpha Strike and grounds you, and her E stun is lethal near walls, so dash only once her W is spent.

edits.before: Her W negates Alpha Strike's blink and Highlander's movement, so it gates my entire engage; her E needs a wall to stun and her Q knockup interrupts my channel — Meditate can't be used mid-CC. My only safe play into an up W is to wait it out, since Alpha Strike's untargetability does NOT dodge a point-and-click E-charge once she's on top of me.
edits.after: Her W stops dashes outright and grounds you when it does, so it gates my entire engage — the in AND the out; her E needs a wall to stun and her Q interrupts my channel, so Meditate is unusable mid-CC. Into an up W the only play is to wait it out, since Alpha Strike's untargetability does NOT dodge a point-and-click E-charge once she's on top of me.

edits.before: A true 50/50 EVEN lane — Poppy's W hard-counters my dashes and owns me early, but I out-scale her decisively once itemized; win the lane by surviving to your spike, not by forcing it.
edits.after: An EVEN lane Yi takes 56.29% — Poppy's W hard-counters my dashes and owns me early, but I out-scale her decisively once itemized; win it by surviving to your spike, not forcing it.

notes: All three packet.suspectNames entries (Steadfast Presence x2, Keeper's Verdict) are false positives — both are Poppy's real ability names in the kit file. The genuine defect was the slot, not the name: the page called her W a passive.
